title: Classification and regression evaluation metrics
description: Confusion matrix, accuracy pitfalls, precision/recall/F1, MAE/RMSE/R squared, baselines, cost-based thresholds and choosing a metric from the business cost.

title: ROC curves, AUC and precision-recall curves
description: Threshold sweeps, ROC and precision-recall curves, and AUC as the probability that a random positive outscores a random negative.

title: Probability calibration
description: Reliability diagrams, expected calibration error and the Brier score; ranking versus honest probabilities.

title: Feature engineering
description: Scaling, categorical encoding, hashing, feature crosses, missing-value handling and feature selection.

title: Class imbalance
description: Why rare classes are hard and how resampling, class weights, cost-sensitive loss and threshold moving address it.

title: Data leakage
description: How information from test data, the future or the label contaminates training, and how to split and preprocess to prevent it.

title: Gaussian mixture models
description: Mixture densities, the latent component variable, soft clustering, covariance structure and singularities.

title: The EM algorithm
description: E-step responsibilities, M-step updates, monotone increase of the log-likelihood and initialisation for latent-variable models.
